content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Mara's replay proposal became the HarborMesh prototype that the human reporter said the team tested together.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Our code body recorded on 2026-04-16 that we were prototyping the replay adapter agreed with Mara.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"We had also authored HarborMesh's sensor scheduler.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human field-trial report reached our code body on 2026-05-03.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"According to that report, the April 30 trial correctly replayed buffered readings through an outage.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The team paused wider rollout on May 2 until calibration drift was understood.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As of the 2026-05-03 report, there was no production deployment yet.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record whether rollout later resumed.","support":[3],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The recorded entry point for checking present state is docs/STATUS.md in https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"My receiving voice body has no source network or repository runtime access to check that state.","support":[],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
